data.name: Liquid-helium dewar
data.function: Storage dewar for the liquid helium used to pre-cool the cryostat and to top up the mixture reservoir. A cryogen-free system needs it only during maintenance, which is the point: the pulse tube replaced a standing helium supply, and the dewars remain for the rare occasions when the mixture must be recovered or the insert warmed and re-cooled quickly. Boil-off is continuous, so a dewar left connected is a slow leak of an expensive gas.

physics.summary: Cryogen storage for pre-cooling and mixture recovery.
